# d462n row P1-plain-folder: item t-1, project plain, earlier step none, between the runs none.
isolate

subst flow/wf.star
subst fake/claude
chmod 755 fake/claude

exec beehavereal item add plain t-1 --title 'The item' --body-file body.txt
! exec beehavereal run t-1 plain --workflow flow/wf.star &
waitfile started
kill -KILL
wait

exec sh any.sh run run t-1 plain --workflow flow/wf.star
exec cat run.err

# control: the second start got the note
exists prompt.2
grep 'This step ran before' prompt.2
! grep 'The engine found no change to tracked files since the step started' prompt.2
! grep 'The engine read this summary of the changes' prompt.2

-- any.sh --
label=$1
shift
beehavereal "$@" > "$label.out" 2> "$label.err"
echo $? > "$label.rc"
-- body.txt --
The body.
-- origin/readme.txt --
The source repository.
-- origin/BASE_MARKER --
base marker
-- origin/MOVED_MARKER --
moved
-- config/projects/plain.star --
# The sandbox is off because a sandboxed step here ends not-started: the tree has no git user.name or user.email, and the fake claude prints version 1.0.0, below the version that the sandbox needs.
project(sandbox = "off")
-- flow/wf.star --
def main(item):
    agent(name = "probe", prompt = "prompts/probe.md", model = "m")
-- flow/prompts/probe.md --
Probe the folder.
-- fake/claude --
#!/bin/sh
if [ "${1:-}" = "--version" ]; then echo 1.0.0; exit 0; fi
n=$(cat "@WORK@/starts" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)
n=$((n + 1))
echo "$n" > "@WORK@/starts"
cat > "@WORK@/prompt.$n"
if [ "$n" -eq 1 ]; then
	echo y > AGENT_WORK
	echo x > "@WORK@/started"
	sleep 30
fi
echo '{"type":"result","session_id":"s1","result":"done"}'
